text:
Who do we have here?
A new aspirant?
zh:
看看这是谁？
一位新的求道者？

text: Ahh, you again.
zh: 啊，又是你。

text: Or is it a mere traveler?
zh: 还是说，只是个过路的旅人？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: What are you doing here?
zh: 你在这里做什么？

text: I will help you with the gems.
zh: 我来帮你找宝石。

text: Here, I have some gems to spare.
zh: 给，我这里有些多余的宝石。

text: Here, I have some gems to spare.
zh: 给，我这里有些多余的宝石。

text: How to I access the temple?
zh: 我要怎么进入神殿？

text: I am on my way.
zh: 我先走了。

text:
I don't have a name.
Just like every other member of our sacred bond.
zh:
我没有名字。
就像我们神圣盟约中的每一位成员一样。

text: Only our leader was given a name by our god.
zh: 只有我们的领袖获得了神赐予的名字。

text: I usually study the power of small gems and their effects on our bodies.
zh: 我平日研究小型宝石的力量，以及它们对我们身体的影响。

text: However, my last gem broke during one of my experiments.
zh: 然而，我最后一颗宝石在一次实验中碎掉了。

text:
Thinking about it...
You could help me out a bit.
zh:
这么一想……
你倒是可以帮我一把。

text:
What do you think?
Can you bring me some gems so I can continue my experiments?
zh:
你意下如何？
能给我带些宝石来，让我继续我的实验吗？

text: I will bring you a gem.
zh: 我会给你带一颗宝石来。

text: Where can I find gems?
zh: 我在哪里能找到宝石？

text: I don't have time for that.
zh: 我没时间管这个。

text:
Wonderful.
Let me know as soon as you have some gems to spare.
zh:
太好了。
你一有多余的宝石，就来告诉我。

text:
The creatures around here may have gems in their innards.
Apparently they find the gems in the mud around here.
zh:
这一带的生物腹中可能藏有宝石。
它们似乎是在附近的泥浆里找到这些宝石的。

text: Alternatively, you may find gems at merchants.
zh: 或者，你也可以在商人那里找到宝石。

text: Shame...
zh: 可惜……

text: I'll still be here in case you change your mind.
zh: 如果你改变主意，我还会在这里。

text: Let me see.
zh: 让我看看。

text: Here's a small green gem.
zh: 这是一颗小绿宝石。

text: Here's a small red gem.
zh: 这是一颗小红宝石。

text: Here's a small blue gem.
zh: 这是一颗小蓝宝石。

text: Here's a small yellow gem.
zh: 这是一颗小黄宝石。

text: Here's a small blood gem.
zh: 这是一颗小血宝石。

text: I don't have any gems.
zh: 我没有宝石。

text: Come back later.
zh: 那就以后再来吧。

text:
Very well!
With this one I may be able to do more experiments.
zh:
很好！
有了这颗，我或许能做更多实验了。

text: Be careful around here.
zh: 在这一带小心些。

text: Our spiritual leader B'Oldar does not open the temple to everyone.
zh: 我们的精神领袖博尔达尔不会向所有人敞开神殿。

text: Unless you are a brother of our community, you will not be allowed to enter.
zh: 除非你是我们教团的兄弟，否则不得入内。

text:
However, there were exceptions.
Strong fighters were allowed to enter our sacred temple under certain circumstances.
zh:
不过，也有过例外。
在特定情况下，强大的战士曾被允许进入我们神圣的神殿。

text:
I think you too have the potential to do so.
It would be best to speak to B'Oldar.
zh:
我认为你也有这样的潜质。
最好去和博尔达尔谈谈。

text: Although you already seem quite strong, you will need to gain a little more experience in combat to be allowed to enter the temple.
zh: 虽然你看起来已经相当强大，但你还需要再积累一些战斗经验，才能获准进入神殿。

text: But you don't seem to be strong enough for that yet.
zh: 但你现在似乎还不够强大。

text:
You should consider joining us before entering the temple.
So far, none of the fighters have come out of the temple.
zh:
在进入神殿之前，你应该考虑加入我们。
到目前为止，还没有一个战士从神殿里出来过。
